later_xbrl_role: audit reference only; never selected, replaced or fed a value into any feature
motivation: Direct correction of the measurement failure reported by the Earnings Information Absorption branch, which used previously filed XBRL rather than the figures announced on the day.

dev_sample.rule: SHA-256 rank of 'PIT_EARNINGS_SURPRISE_V2_DEV_SAMPLE|ticker|fiscal_period|accession', first 2 per ticker; no reference to returns

rate_definition: validation_rate_gate_definition = validated / extracted, the gate's denominator. validated_among_comparable = validated / (validated + contradicted), excluding extractions with no later-XBRL reference in window; reported for diagnosis only and is not a substitute for the gate metric.
diagnosed_failure_modes: Wrong row selection: 'Sales and maturities of marketable securities' (a cash-flow-statement line) was selected as revenue in 22 events; revenue row patterns anchored on 'sales' match non-income-statement rows in filers whose income statement uses different wording.

Wrong column or unit scale: operating income is contradicted in 195 of 271 comparable extractions, consistent with selecting a prior-year column or misresolving thousands/millions where the unit caption sits outside the table markup.
failure_mode_note: Not 'reliable extraction but no predictive value' and not 'predictive value eliminated by costs'. Neither was reached. Whether point-in-time earnings surprises predict post-announcement drift remains untested here.
correction_to_interim_statement: An interim diagnostic in development reported zero reference mismatches. That was an artifact of the audit table recording the reference value only on a successful match, which made contradictions invisible. The corrected counts are recorded above (revenue 114, operating income 195, diluted EPS 44 contradicted) and make the gate failure more clear-cut, not less.
most_important_limitation: Correct measurement of release-day figures is the binding constraint and is an engineering problem, not a modeling one. A deterministic multi-filer Exhibit 99.1 table parser reaching 90% audit validation on all three GAAP components was not achievable within the time budget. A credible successor needs per-filer income-statement templates or table-structure identification of the income statement before row matching, validated on held-out filers.
